// A record whose name starts with an underscore never captures its class
// name, so its compact constructor body is scanned by the global state.
// The `while` statement keyword below must not be taken for a function name
// there; the expected result is lizard's own.
record _K(int x) {
    _K {
        while (x > 3) { x = x - 1; }
    }
}
